{{Top|leg}}
The '''Speed of the Toocha''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] technique, where a Nightsister is imbued with short bursts of blindingly fast speed and energized leaps to cover remarkable distance. It seems like a variation, or another name for [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]].
